title: Brown's lost 1929 paper The Minor Quantum

tellings.quote: In 1929, he wrote a paper. He was kind of cutting back, but yeah, in 1929 he writes a paper about the minor quantum.

plain: In 1929, Thomas Townsend Brown, the researcher at the center of one of Michels' documentaries, wrote a paper called The Minor Quantum that has since been lost. Michels mentions it himself, without saying how he knows of it, while telling the story of Brown's early years. For Michels it matters because Brown is the man he calls the scientist who built UFOs before anyone had heard of them.
